scripts.bundle: spago bundle --package durable-mini --module Frontend.Chat --outfile public/chat.js --platform browser --bundle-type app && spago bundle --package durable-mini --module Frontend.Counter --outfile public/counter.js --platform browser --bundle-type app && npm run bundle:lab
scripts.bundle:lab: spago bundle --package durable-ui --module UI.Lab --outfile ../public/ui-lab.js --platform browser --bundle-type app
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run bundle && npm run config && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run bundle && npm run config && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: spago test -p durable-mini && npm run test:ui
